default_mode: simulation; empty baseUrl; testApiSession=null in memory; no login or network on load

modes.simulation: Existing local model only; no wx.request and no live messages/orders/payments.
modes.isolated-api: Explicitly configured loopback API and ephemeral test session only; no real money. Missing session or invalid destination fails closed.
modes.wechat-api: Explicit environment=wechat, compiled HTTPS /api URL and matching appId. User-click login only: wx.login, backend code exchange, customer JWT and /auth/me verification. Native ordering/payment remain NOT_CONNECTED. No fallback to simulation or TEST.

session_contract: Only the explicitly approved temporary local TEST runtime may grant an in-memory customer JWT after an operator matches the native page pairing code using the local console. Subject/database/TEST store/issuer/audience are bound; one claim, expires with the short window. This is not WeChat login. No real account or persistent external credential is created; tokens and pairing request IDs are not persisted.
read_routes: GET /api/orders/environment (CUSTOMER JWT; server verifies actual database connection)
write_route: POST /api/orders with existing requestId, selection, server-quoted expectedTotalAmount and testEnvironment=isolated-test; amount is recomputed by server before any debit.
backend_patch: Environment handshake, server-owned TEST marking, and TEST list/receipt fields are applied to the original API source. No running API/PG or platform connection is claimed.

idempotency.before_submit: Save requestId/payload and test subject/endpoint, never tokens. Storage failure blocks POST.
idempotency.unknown: Keep original identity across page/client restart and deny new POST. Refresh reads original receipt; absence cannot authorize a replacement.
idempotency.confirmed: Display server orderNo and next step; subsequent refresh failure preserves the success receipt.
idempotency.explicit_not_committed: Only server requestOutcome=NOT_COMMITTED clears the pending request; invalidate quote and require a new quote and user confirmation.
idempotency.account_change: Clear visible prior identity data, preserve old scoped pending request, reject stale callbacks.

not_implemented: live WeChat login/platform verification (source implemented; synthetic tests only)
actual production API configuration (configuration boundary implemented; nothing activated)
approval_needed: any new credentials/login/deployment or platform security configuration
parent-assigned isolated API/PG runtime window and exact execution scope
recording: Use actual native controls and actual isolated API responses after integration. Label isolated ledger and simulated sections. No deleted video recovery.
quote_route: POST /api/orders/preview, read-only; require current subject/selection/TEST store, preserve exact amount as decimal text, show it before confirmation.

isolated_server_contract.guard: Reject production NODE_ENV, malformed configuration, non-loopback database peer or current_database mismatch. TEST marking is not granted by client flags. Fresh isolated data and outbound configuration still require runtime verification.
isolated_server_contract.DFC_TEST_SUBJECT: UUID v4 of the approved fresh synthetic CUSTOMER; no real account
isolated_server_contract.identity: Ephemeral in-memory JWT; issuer dfc-isolated-local, audience dfc-native-isolated, subject/database/store claims match server-owned config. Existing live JWT behavior is unchanged.
isolated_server_contract.network: Application TCP/HTTP guards retain exact configured loopback ports. Only dns.lookup/dns.promises.lookup for exact 127.0.0.1 or ::1 uses the native literal-IP fast path; all other DNS, HTTPS/TLS/UDP/fetch are blocked. Native Prisma requires the validated fresh loopback TEST URL. No OS firewall changes.
isolated_server_contract.preparation_status: Short interactive mode now prepared in the existing guard/runner/cases; separate DFC_LOCAL_TEST_API_PG_INTERACTIVE scope and 15..90 seconds required. Actual new mode awaits a parent serial window.
isolated_server_contract.host_normalization: SQL host(inet_server_addr()) supplies the canonical address; only exact 127.0.0.1 or ::1 remains accepted. Diagnostic output contains naming/match flags and host classes, never URL or credential values.
